### Line 350

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-structures.library.plato, line 350](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-structures.library.plato#L350).

```plato

    //==
    // # Derived functionality for spatial indexes and queries
    //
    // Pure, expression-bodied helpers for the interfaces declared in
    // `spatial.concepts.plato` (ISpatialIndex2D, ISpatialIndex3D) and
    // `spatial.concepts.plato` (IRaycast2D/3D,
    // IClosestPoint2D/3D, INearestNeighbor2D/3D). Part of P8 of the
    // interface library.
    //
    // Result records expose their fields, so hit/distance predicates just read them,
    // and the convenience overloads assemble the query records so a caller can cast a
    // bare ray or ask for a bare k-nearest count. Emptiness follows one pattern —
    // `IsEmpty` wherever no overload clash forces a prefixed spelling (per-interface
    // `IsEmpty` collisions are disambiguated by interface type).

    //==
    // ISpatialIndex2D — broad-phase candidate queries over indexed 2D primitives.
    // Candidates may include false positives; exact tests are the caller's phase two.

    // True when the index holds no primitives.
    IsEmpty(self: ISpatialIndex2D): Boolean
        => self.ItemCount.IsZero;
```
